hlg_fa460b49e451de84_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Fitness Users to request personalized workout recommendations tailored to their fitness profile and preferences, and daily activity suggestions aligned with their fitness goals and current activity level.
hlg_fa460b49e451de84_001.rationale: This High-Level Goal is a lossless reconstruction of the provided Low-Level Goals. llg_001 contributes the capability for Fitness Users to request a list of workout recommendations, specifically noting that these recommendations are tailored to their current fitness profile and preferences. llg_002 adds the distinct capability for Fitness Users to request suggestions for daily activities, emphasizing that these suggestions align with their fitness goals and current activity level. The reconstructed HLG explicitly combines both types of personalized guidance (workout recommendations and daily activity suggestions) along with their respective tailoring criteria, without losing any detail or inferring additional functionality.

Voting result 3/3 for KEEP_ORIGINAL_HIGH_LEVEL_GOAL. The project description explicitly supports the Fitness User receiving personalized workout recommendations. The original HLG outcome set is {receive tailored workout suggestions, receive tailored activity suggestions}. The reconstruction HLG' outcome set is {request personalized workout recommendations, request personalized daily activity suggestions}. Both sets cover the same two functional capabilities (workouts and activities) with identical tailoring criteria (fitness profile, preferences, goals, activity level). The actor is consistent. The HLG is a valid, supported stakeholder outcome distinct from tracking, monitoring, or goal setting. The reconstruction is a lossless aggregate of the LLGs.
